reason: Ferran Torres scored Spain's opening goal against Iraq and also hit the crossbar, providing the strongest immediate role-and-form signal for the June 8 Peru friendly. Oyarzabal was among the key players rested because of fitness concerns, although the coach's promise of broader participation in the final warm-up keeps him almost level with Torres.

Cherki scored France's opener against Ivory Coast and was described as France's best first-half player, with the performance strengthening his case for minutes. Because Iraq is France's final group match and therefore carries rotation risk, Cherki enters the five-outcome slate while Mbappe remains the clear leader.
